_why: ADR 0047 three-language rule as a gate. Exemptions and violations are different lists. An exemption is a condition a new container must meet. A violation is a known miss, not a permission.
exemption_conditions: we ship no source into it

exemptions.reason: third-party oxigraph, unforked, digest-pinned, no build context and no bind-mount of our source
third-party nats-server, unforked, digest-pinned, no build context and no bind-mount of our source (ADR 0065)

third-party Milvus, unforked, digest-pinned, no build context and no bind-mount of our source; it is the rag INDEX and the rag.* contract is a Rails ROLE beside it (RagContainer.md option 3), so the engine's language never becomes the pod's

violations.reason: Node today; target is Rust. Row 11 unblocked (15/18/19 decided). Scope is docs/architecture/SWITCHYARD.md. Not an exemption.

Bun front-base (ADR 0072), reached. The Rails ROLE=front stopgap ended once FLOOR-FRONT.json carried a measured human digest (sha256:01992b23, rev c44c62e, 2026-09-17); the service now builds runtimes/mind-pod/front FROM front-base:local as mind-pod-front, and .cpcp/deploy.json declares that base so bin/docker-containers builds it rather than reaching Docker Hub.
